descFull: AI-first 3D & AR SDK for Android (Jetpack Compose + Filament), Apple (SwiftUI + RealityKit) and the web. An assistant reads llms.txt and writes code that compiles first try; also available as an MCP server and a ChatGPT/Codex plugin. Loads glTF/GLB, USDZ, 3MF and more, and opens them in AR at real size.
